method.native: Pinned pfSense rule compiler without a binding. Both gateways remain healthy.
method.sdwan: Real package observer --once, polled by the lab. A new decision loads the compiled rule in FreeBSD PF.
method.client: Independent TCP, persistent TCP, backup TCP and DNS probes use the same destinations and cadence in both modes.
method.fault: Peer PF drops the ERP TCP service and its standby probe on WAN1 only.
